title: Chromatic Legibility Anchors and Tactile Radius Tokens for Keyboard-First Navigation
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Introduce a focused token subset that improves color legibility under keyboard focus and high-contrast modes, and formalize a tactile radius token set (press-depth / focus halo) for action controls and table rows. This work aims to reduce visual ambiguity for keyboard and screen-reader users while preserving the visual language for dense analytics surfaces.

Goals:
- Define 6 semantic color anchors (foreground/interactive/neutral/positive/warning/critical) with explicit contrast ratios for: normal text, UI icons, and focused/active states. Include variants for 4 contrast bands (AA body, AA large, AAA large, and focus halo minimum) and document use-cases.
- Create a compact typographic delta mapping (base scale + keyboard/compact variant) so focus outlines do not clip when type scale changes across responsive breakpoints.
- Formalize tactile radius tokens: tactile-xs, tactile-s, tactile-m, tactile-l mapped to physical press-depth metaphors (micro, touch, press, pronounced) that drive border-radius, inner shadow offsets, and focus halo spread.
- Rework elevation shadow presets used for interactive rows and dropdown panels to use a new elevation ramp (elev-0..elev-6) with explicit blur, offset, and alpha that maintain perceived depth at both light and dark themes.
- Provide clear migration guidance and codemods for components: Button, Table Row, Action Row, Dropdown, and Tooltip.

Acceptance criteria:
- Token spec published in the design system repo with explicit hex/rgba values and contrast calculations for each variant.
- Design token tokens.json exported with new keys: color.anchor.* color.focus.* type.scale.keyboard.* radius.tactile.* elevation.elev-*.
- Visual QA screens for desktop and compact mobile showing: default vs keyboard focus vs high-contrast; table row hover/focus/selected with tactile radii applied.
- A small codemod PR lives in the component library replacing previous radius/shadow variables in Button and Table components (non-blocking fallback).
- Documentation page updated with examples and migration notes; accessibility checklist added.

Out of scope:
- Full theme rebrand or palette overhaul across marketing site. This ticket focuses on tokens and targeted component changes only.

Notes: prioritize contrast math for small UI icons and focus halos (often under-tested). Work closely with R&D to confirm shadow values render consistently on the runtime (Chromium-based) build pipeline.
